collection_dispositions.rationale: These fifty portraits carry the strongest founder-recognized Starlight continuity and premium emotion, but their repeated humanoid, halo, pedestal, and ceremonial cues are not operational truth.
The sheet is useful for comparing silhouette and facial architecture, especially architectural and screenless seeds, but most candidates repeat generic tall humanoid robot grammar.
Frank explicitly rejected this visual direction; it remains only as textual negative evidence so future makers do not accidentally revive the same style family.

The boards establish a valuable role-shaped morphology vocabulary, but every image is a design sketch rather than a character master and the selected families still need silhouette and small-crop proof.
The set contains useful craft and composition hypotheses, but the independent review found no production-approved identity and the founder has not selected a replacement direction.
Its maker-verifier-human-gate staging is the strongest workflow seed, but every interface element and label must be rebuilt deterministically and its pixels are not approved for production.
The pilot scored twenty-one of thirty: strong tactile craft and human handoff, but weak Lyra identity preservation, missing routing function, and generic premium humanoid robot styling.

surface_contracts.character_mode: One signature character performing one meaningful act inside a specific world.

surface_contracts.character_mode: Editorial cast storytelling with strong silhouette contrast and episodic handoffs.
